text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle possesses immense talent. 
However, her body forces her training to 
be approached with extreme caution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the Trainer supported KS Miracle with 
a homemade nutritional meal, she happily 
called them "kind." Those words left the 
Trainer with a lingering sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of her first race, KS 
Miracle savored the joy of being able to 
run. With her friends watching over her, 
her debut race began.
